description_en: Queries the column encryption algorithm configuration of a specified instance
description_zh: 查询指定实例的列加密算法配置信息
name: DescribeDBInstanceCLS

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

AES_128_CBC
AES_128_GCM
AES_128_CTR
AES_128_ECB
AES_256_CBC
AES_256_GCM
AES_256_CTR
AES_256_ECB
SM4_128_CBC
SM4_128_GCM
SM4_128_CTR
SM4_128_ECB
Algorithm.description_zh:
加密使用的算法。可以选择：

AES_128_CBC
AES_128_GCM
AES_128_CTR
AES_128_ECB
AES_256_CBC
AES_256_GCM
AES_256_CTR
AES_256_ECB
SM4_128_CBC
SM4_128_GCM
SM4_128_CTR
SM4_128_ECB

EncryptionKey.description_en:
The custom KMS master key ID.

This parameter takes effect only when the column encryption key pattern is set to kms_key. If this parameter is not specified, the current column encryption key settings of the database remain unchanged
EncryptionKey.description_zh:
自定义KMS主密钥 ID。
说明
仅当列加密密钥模式为kms_key时生效。如果不传入，则不变更当前数据库列加密密钥设置

EncryptionKeyMode.description_en:
The column encryption key mode. Valid values:

client_key: configures a user-generated random key on the client side.
kms_key: configures a custom key by using Alibaba Cloud Key Management Service (KMS).

After an instance is configured to use KMS for key management, you can no longer switch back to the client-side random key mode
EncryptionKeyMode.description_zh:
列加密密钥模式。可以选择：

client_key（在客户端侧配置用户自行生成的随机密钥）
kms_key（使用阿里云KMS配置自定义密钥）

说明
一旦实例被设置成使用KMS配置密钥，将无法再使用客户端侧配置随机密钥的方式

WhiteListMode.description_en: Indicates whether the whitelist mode is enabled
